comments.text: Context: This game takes place before any of the games (1979), set in Edwin Murray's facility. Edwin Murray in the books was tasked with turning the fabric suits from fall fest (a carnival owned by William Afton), into animatronics. Being an overworked father, he didn't have much time to spend time with his 4 year old son. So, he created the mimic. As stated in the office, it has the ability to copy behaviors and personas of other people. However, one day, Edwins son got ran over by a car. But the mimic still copied the boys actions, making Edwin furious. In a fit of rage, he beat the mimic, tearing its body apart. But it survived, and now, it was copying Edwin's violent actions against anyone it saw. Edwin disappeared, and fazbear entertainment went to collect what was theirs. The mimic was still at the facility though, and the people sent there were killed by it. It's also the thing that lured Cassie with Gregory's voice in ruin. Fiona went to fall fest because she felt something was wrong, only for it to burn down while she was there and she died. Also, the white tiger cory sees is named tiger rock, it's a plushie that David had (his favorite) before he died and the mimic therefore uses its appearance. In the books it actually controlled the pizzaplex. I did some researching, $25 in 1979 is equal to $110.79 today. So Arnold is doing all of this for about 100 dollars (which is a lot more reasonable than $25)
